images.prompt:
Create a high quality industrial-design concept board for a handheld Bluetooth air mouse computer controller, pistol-shaped ergonomic grip for a right hand. It is a sealed 3D-printable plastic electronics housing with no weapon mechanism. ALL labels in clear simplified Chinese. The control requirements are STRICT: exactly one ordinary black five-pin PS2 potentiometer thumb joystick with a broad independent replaceable mounting pod; its press is mouse middle click, one separate mouse right-click button beside/below it on the LEFT flank where the right thumb wraps around, and one index-finger trigger. The TRIGGER FACE itself has capacitive touch under a thin insulating plastic surface AND a mechanically distinct left-click press. NO touch area anywhere on the grip; middle/ring/little fingers only stabilize the grip. No trackball, no extra controls, no scroll wheel, no PS4/PS5 or TMR stick. Removable left/right half shells, restrained seam and screw details are visual concepts only. USB-C at grip base, allow cable access. Matte gray plastic with only the trigger touch face highlighted muted blue. Full enclosure remains a hand-sized concept: exploratory envelope length 180, thickness 40, height 135 mm, not manufacturing dimensions. Footer: "概念效果图｜模块尺寸、孔位及手感待实测". Do not show internal electronics fitting or claim accurate scaled holes.
Use the attached old design as an appearance reference, replacing obsolete controls exactly as requested. REMOVE the old blue oval on the front grip completely, make this area continuous gray molded plastic in EVERY VIEW. Put a narrow blue inset exclusively on the front concave surface of the black mechanical trigger, reachable naturally by the index finger. Keep the short, softly rounded upper enclosure and modular thumb control layout but enlarge the joystick mounting pod modestly to acknowledge an ordinary PS2 module. Landscape concept board, one large three-quarter LEFT view plus two smaller matching side/rear views. Title "A｜圆润短顶罩". Callouts "触摸＋按压扳机", "普通 PS2 摇杆", "独立摇杆安装座", "鼠标右键（位置待验证）". Small two-line note: "轻触：体感开启　继续按压：左键" / "松压仍接触：体感继续　离开：体感停止". Every view must show the same updated design with gray grip and blue trigger only.

images.file: C-触摸与机械点击分开检测.png
images.prompt: Create a clear simplified-Chinese industrial design explanatory board for the double-function capacitive TOUCH + mechanical CLICK trigger of a handheld computer air mouse. It is an electronic mouse input component, not a weapon mechanism. Landscape light gray studio background, precise concept illustrations, no fictional dimensions or exact drill coordinates. Title "C｜触摸与机械点击分开检测". Left half: enlarged exploded concept of a black curved removable trigger cap with a small blue thin INSULATING PLASTIC front surface, a copper foil electrode hidden immediately under that surface and firmly attached to the MOVING CAP; a single short flexible wire with gentle strain-relief loop to a STATIONARY separate blue capacitive detector board behind, labels "薄塑料触摸表面", "内侧电极", "柔性引线与应力释放", "触摸检测板（固定）". Adjacent simple view shows the cap on an upper pivot, molded push lug acting on a separate tiny microswitch lever in a fixed holder, shell molded hard-stop taking overtravel force. Labels "独立微动开关", "固定件", "壳体机械限位"; do NOT mark a final lever length or switch mounting holes, make clear it is a principle sketch. NO electrode on grip, no coil/fire mechanism, no finalized main PCB. Right half: four small human INDEX FINGER/contact pictograms in a vertical sequence, the blue trigger surface clearly accessible. EXACT four bold state labels and sublabels: "① 未接触" / "体感关闭"; "② 轻触" / "体感开启，左键未按"; "③ 继续按压" / "体感开启，左键按下"; "④ 松压但仍接触" / "体感继续，左键释放". Separate arrow leaving the surface back to state① with note "完全离开：体感停止". Bottom note "两路独立输入｜移动电极需验证灵敏度、引线寿命和抗干扰｜示意结构，非加工图". Keep electrode/skin/board identities consistent and prioritize clear touch principle over realistic switch subpart detail.
